name: a client script and references, no footage

draft.summary: A 30 to 35 second social ad for PINEWOOD Home Services, made without footage from the client’s script, scene directions and references. It opens on a dirty skylight with an DIRTY WINDOW ALERT, explains what can build up in skylights and the AC system, then reveals the limited-time $97 window cleaning special with a free AC inspection and the included dryer-window cleaning, and ends on a request-your-appointment card. Deliver 9:16 and 1:1. No phone number anywhere.
draft.goal: Get homeowners to request an appointment for the $97 window cleaning special
draft.tone: Realistic, trustworthy and premium; educational and serious at first, then positive and energetic from the offer on
draft.pacing: Moderate narration, slightly faster during the offer; the final screen stays up at least 2.5 to 3 seconds

hook.what: A dirty skylight with green particles and the DIRTY WINDOW ALERT, two alert sounds

mustInclude.what: The only text in the opening shot
The $97 price, the strongest visual element of the offer
The original transparent PINEWOOD logo on the final screen

mustAvoid.what: Extra labels in the opening shot such as Dust, Pollen or Rain Spots
Saying that the glass is damaged
The old $79 price and “BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT”

music.note: Engaging background music after the second alert, under the voiceover to the end: serious at first, more positive at “That’s why”, strongest at the $97 reveal, “And that’s not all” and the final call to action

lines.text: You always think about the paint on your walls and the floors you walk on…
But what about the view you look at every day?
lines.direction: stress BUT, with a short pause after it, and give the whole question weight
slightly quieter, thought-provoking, then a brief natural pause

lines.text: Dust, pollen, and rain spots can collect on your windows and screens.
That’s why, for a limited time, PINEWOOD Home Services is offering window cleaning for only ninety-seven dollars, including a free screen inspection.
lines.direction: turn positive and solution-focused at “That’s why”; strong emphasis on “only ninety-seven dollars”

lines.text: And that’s not all—your basic gutter cleaning is included in the same ninety-seven-dollar special!
lines.direction: an exciting bonus reveal on “And that’s not all”

lines.text: Get it now and save. Tap below to request your appointment.

references.takeaway: Shot order, pacing, caption style (white bold caps on a dark-navy box with key words in brand blue) and offer graphics to match; the same kind of video, not a copy

files.note: The reference video: 35 s, 9:16. Style to match, never in the video
Unpacked by the engine; its files are listed below
7.5 s clip of a dusty skylight
The old ad: still says $79 and “BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT”; the offer is now $97 and “REQUEST YOUR APPOINTMENT”

assumptions: The client’s text asks for 9:16 and 1:1, so both are delivered and 9:16 is the main format.
The brand blue #2F6FDE is sampled from the logo.
